project.name: salesforce-fastmcp

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the project's purpose: a FastMCP server providing 54 Salesforce analytics and CRUD tools for Southern Europe channel management. This document outlines the architecture, setup instructions, and the two-laptop integration pattern that enables Claude Desktop to interact with the server remotely.

tour.title: MCP Server Gateway
tour.description: The server.py file is the entry point that bootstraps the FastMCP server and registers all 54 tools as MCP endpoints. It imports three core modules (channel_intelligence, salesforce_client, and prompts) and handles the stdio/HTTP transport layer, making analytics available to Claude Desktop through the MCP protocol.
tour.languageLesson: Python MCP servers register callable functions as tools by importing and exposing them to the MCP framework. The server handles bidirectional communication with Claude Desktop, marshalling requests and responses through the FastMCP transport.

tour.title: Core Analytics Engine
tour.description: The channel_intelligence.py module implements the 35+ business intelligence functions that power all analytics queries: revenue analysis, pipeline health, partner engagement, opportunity tracking, deal registrations, and risk metrics. It serves as the single source of truth for analytics logic, consuming both Salesforce data and configuration.
tour.languageLesson: Centralized analytics engines reduce duplication across interfaces (MCP, CLI, tests) by housing business logic in one module. This pattern allows server.py and cli/channel_cli.py to import and call the same functions without code replication.

tour.title: Salesforce API Integration
tour.description: The salesforce_client.py module provides the async HTTP client that executes SOQL queries, CRUD operations, and analytics queries against the Salesforce REST API. It abstracts authentication, request marshalling, and error handling, providing a clean interface for channel_intelligence to query Salesforce data.
tour.languageLesson: Async HTTP clients (httpx in this case) enable efficient concurrent requests to remote APIs. The client maintains a session and connection pool, reducing latency when executing multiple Salesforce queries in sequence.

tour.title: Configuration Management
tour.description: The ci_config.py module manages YAML-based revenue targets and partner name normalization without requiring Salesforce custom fields. The ConfigManager class loads targets from sales_targets.yaml and provides territory, country, and partner-level lookups, enabling attainment calculations and fuzzy partner matching.
tour.languageLesson: Configuration-driven systems separate business data (targets, thresholds) from code, allowing channel directors to adjust targets without redeploying. YAML is human-readable and version-controllable, making it ideal for managing multi-level hierarchies (territory > country > partner).

tour.title: Fiscal Calendar & SOQL Queries
tour.description: The ci_fiscal.py module provides fiscal calendar utilities that normalize period references (THIS_QUARTER, FY27_Q1) into date ranges. It constructs the SOQL queries that fetch data for the specified periods, supporting the Feb-Jan fiscal year convention used across Southern Europe operations.
tour.languageLesson: Fiscal calendars are often non-standard. By centralizing period normalization in one module, the entire system can refer to periods symbolically (e.g., 'THIS_QUARTER') without hardcoding dates, making queries maintainable across fiscal year changes.

tour.title: LLM Prompt Templates
tour.description: The prompts.py module is a library of 18 template functions that generate structured prompts for Claude, covering quarterly analysis, partner engagement health, competitive insights, and forecast reporting. Server.py uses these templates to provide intelligent, narrative-driven reporting on top of raw analytics.
tour.languageLesson: Prompt templates extract boilerplate questions and context setup into reusable functions, reducing duplication and ensuring consistent framing across different reports. Templates accept parameters (metrics, filters) and inject them into structured prompts.

tour.title: CLI Interface & Formatters
tour.description: The cli/channel_cli.py module exposes 9 Click commands (kpi, revenue, pipeline, partner, qbr, risk, etc.) and 24+ formatter functions, allowing analysts to run analytics from the terminal and output results in JSON, tabular, or KPI card formats. It imports channel_intelligence and salesforce_client directly, bypassing the MCP server for automation workflows.

tour.title: Environment & Authentication
tour.description: The .env.example file documents required environment variables for Salesforce authentication (SALESFORCE_BASE_URL, SALESFORCE_SID) and MCP transport configuration. These credentials are loaded at runtime by server.py and salesforce_client.py to authenticate API requests and enable secure communication.

tour.title: Remote Access via Proxy
tour.description: The proxy.py script enables a two-laptop architecture: Claude Desktop on one laptop connects to the FastMCP server on another via a stdio-to-HTTP bridge over Tailscale. This pattern allows secure, seamless interaction with Salesforce data without exposing the server to the internet.
tour.languageLesson: stdio-to-HTTP bridges decouple local development environments from remote servers. The proxy handles session management and error recovery, ensuring robust communication over unreliable networks or Tailscale tunnels.

tour.title: Analytics Unit Tests
tour.description: The tests/test_analytics.py module provides 28 unit test assertions for core analytics functions using mocked Salesforce responses. These tests validate revenue calculations, pipeline aggregations, growth metrics, KPI snapshots, and multi-period trends without requiring live API access, enabling fast feedback during development.
tour.languageLesson: Unit tests with mocked external dependencies (Salesforce API) run in milliseconds, enabling rapid iteration. Fixtures capture real API response shapes, ensuring test assertions reflect actual data structures without needing live accounts.

tour.title: Integration Tests
tour.description: The tests/test_integration.py module contains 59 integration tests that validate the entire system against a live MCP server and Salesforce instance. These tests exercise all major workflows (revenue, pipeline, KPI, QBR, risk, registrations) and edge cases (period normalization, orphan hygiene, stalled deal detection), ensuring end-to-end correctness.

tour.title: Channel Director Playbook
tour.description: The CHANNEL_DIRECTOR_PLAYBOOK.md is the primary user guide for channel directors using Claude Desktop (MCP interface). It maps daily, weekly, and monthly workflows to the 54 MCP tools, organized by business context (revenue tracking, pipeline health, partner engagement, QBR prep, risk management).

tour.title: CLI Automation Guide
tour.description: The CLI_PLAYBOOK.md targets automation engineers and provides 10 command examples, workflow templates for daily/weekly/monthly reporting, Hermes agent integration, and advanced jq piping for custom reporting. It shows how to automate analytics retrieval and integrate with external scheduling systems.

tour.title: Architecture & Future Roadmap
tour.description: The PHASE_1_IMPLEMENTATION.md documents the technical architecture, tool categories, and design patterns used in the current system, while SCALING_PRIORITIZATION.md outlines the strategic roadmap for future phases (Salesforce completeness, performance optimization, multi-org support, and advanced analytics).
